newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end slightly up, mood cautious.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end slightly up, mood cautious.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index ended up slightly mainly due to rises in Pudong real estate shares, but the cautious market mood deepened with the suspension of Shenzhen Development Bank, brokers said.
The index edged up 0.434 points or 0.51 percent to 85.481 points on volume of 17.271 million shares worth $11.707 million.
Trading in Shenzhen Development Bank shares was suspended on Monday afternoon by the Shenzhen stock exchange after volatile price movements last Friday and this morning, brokers said.
